decisions.identity: Original 2001 Fleer Ultra Baseball, debut December 2000. Independently cross-checked original 275 base/2 medallion parallels and five four-line insert checklist families. New draft product only.
decisions.base: BCP and independent MCB agree all 275 numbers and names except the four explicitly reviewed cases #39, #47, #70, #270. BCP recognizes 1-225 regular, 226-250 dual-player prospects (not SP), 251-275 single-player prospects 1:4.
decisions.names: Four human-reviewed source name differences: #39 Bob vs Bobby Abreu (Bobby); #47 Dave vs David Justice (David); #70 Bob vs Bobby Higginson (Bobby); #270 Timoniel vs Timo Perez (Timo); other source-specific punctuation ignored.
decisions.gold: 275 authentic G-suffix Medallion: 1G-250G one per ordinary pack, SP 251G-275G 1:24; preserve complete single collector checklist and historical SP in notes.
